text_block_list.text:
One day while straightening up my
office, I find
that hot spring vacation
ticket from before.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Then promise me that you'll take me to
the hot
spring once I've worked hard
enough.

She's really done her best these past
three years...
I guess it's decided then.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo! So this is the inn where we'll be
spending
our hot spring vacation
tonight!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's really charming. This is exactly what I

expected for our trip. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer, you're not looking so hot...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In fact, you look totally exhausted, as if
the
Umamusume you train made you
plan this entire
trip alone while also
carrying all her stuff the
whole way here.
Before setting off for the inn...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're finally going to take me on my
hot spring
vacation!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna go talk with
Hishiama real
quick!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's not it. I want permission to let you
in the
dorm so you can carry my stuff
from my room.
choice_data_list_en: If you need a pass to go out, I can—
If you need a pass to go out, I can—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You promised you'd do eeeverything on
this trip
for me. Remember?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Starting now, I expect to be treated like
a
princess. ♪

And so I've been handling everything,
from
organizing her huge amount of
luggage to...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Traineeer, I'm hungry.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yay! I want milk too! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Traineeer, this seat is so hard. I can't
sleep.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: ネックピロー、持ってきたぞ
ネックピロー、持ってきたよ

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Not good enough! I'm gonna sleep on
your
shoulder.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No moving! Not even a millimeter... Zzz...

After a long trip obeying her every
command, we
finally arrive at the inn.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wow, good work, Trainer. You made
that journey
a piece of cake! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha! You sure are tired, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's get in the hot spring ASAP! A long,
relaxing
dip will melt all your exhaustion
away.
Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... ♪ That felt awesome.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I wanna stay here forever. I'm gonna get
the inn
to adopt me.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aw, come on. You're a meanie.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In that case, go dig out a hot spring
somewhere
close to campus when we get
back.

Even more nonsense than usual... She
must be
taking her role as princess
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really?
choice_data_list: わかった、理事長に相談しよう
choice_data_list_en: Got it. Let's talk to the Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to come up with something on
the spot...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whatever, let's not stand around and
gab
anymore. Should we take a break in
your room?

We continue our silly little conversations
for a
while.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yawn...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah... It's 'cause I'm so warm and comfy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: じゃあ、部屋まで送るよ
choice_data_list_en: Then I'll walk you to your room.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: H-huh? That's weird..

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My hair feels softer than usual.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Could you touch it? What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, just touch it. It's not a big
deal.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Give it a tousle too.

Sky waits silently until I relent and rustle
her hair.
It feels very soft and fluffy, like
a cat.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm... ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it soft? Worthy of a five-star review,
right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you glad you got to touch my soft
hair?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No problem!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You're very kind and honest, Trainer. I'm
really
glad you brought me along with
you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, who knows? Maybe I just like how
easy it is
to manipulate you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. ♪

I sense that Seiun Sky and I have formed
an
irreplaceable bond during this time
together.
